fields.description: Weekly issue of Miami Life dated January 14, 1928. Includes letters to the editor (including a "family problem" letter), commentary on Miami's tolerance and entertainment culture, discussion of Miami Beach landlord-tenant lien law (Senate Bill No. 295, Acts of 1927) and a reported incident involving a landlord seeking police assistance, political satire/column on Dade County sheriff candidates and local conditions, and local notes on utilities and civic matters. Features promotional content for Miami and Miami Beach hotels and nightlife, items on aviation and radio communications (including references to Colonel Charles Lindbergh and Tropical Radio near Opa-locka), and entertainment listings and advertisements for clubs and theaters.
